description: This file defines a utility class 'ReportHelper' in the package 'org.apache.ofbiz.marketing.report'. It provides a static method 'calcConversionRates' to compute marketing metrics such as conversions, order amounts, and conversion rates based on lists of visits and orders, for reporting purposes.

classes.name: ReportHelper
classes.description: Final class providing static methods for marketing report computations.

methods.name: calcConversionRates
methods.description: Calculates conversion statistics given lists of visit and order data, grouped by a key field name.
